study: arrival null -- the floor on the double-hearing technique

method.estimator: the band-limited ENVELOPE cross-correlation (300-3400 Hz, the band the chain carries honestly), with parabolic interpolation around the peak at a 1 ms envelope hop
method.the_null: a signal against a gain-shifted copy of itself: a second microphone with a different gain, and the same arrival, so the lag must be ZERO
method.the_calibration: known delays injected into the signal, and the error in recovering each one
